fact: ANGOP reports the minister reinaugurated INFOSI's requalified Backup Data Center in Luanda on 2026-08-25, which forms part of the government Data Center and Cloud opened in April 2026 at Camama; main site in Camama (Luanda), backup in Luanda (INFOSI), exact backup place not stated beyond Luanda.

PTI reports the government cloud backup centre, housed at INFOSI in Luanda with 48 racks and about 8.5 PB, was reinaugurated on 2026-08-25 and replicates in real time the data of the government data centre at Camama; main site in Camama, backup in Luanda (INFOSI premises).
